meta.title: Integrate Frankencoin: payments, wallets, DeFi and token issuers
meta.description: Four ways to plug into the decentralized Swiss franc: accept payments, list and offer savings, use ZCHF in DeFi, or list your token as collateral.

hero.title: Plug into the Swiss franc that has no issuer.
hero.subtitle: ZCHF is permissionless: you do not need anyone's approval to use it. These are the four integrations we see most, with what you get and where to start.

items.title: Accept or pay out ZCHF
items.description: Shops, card programmes and payroll. Spar accepts ZCHF in stores; GnosisPay cards spend it; Mt Pelerin gives wallets an IBAN.

items.title: List ZCHF, add savings
items.description: Offer a Swiss-franc balance with yield, and earn up to 25% of your users' interest.

items.title: Use ZCHF as liquidity or collateral
items.description: Pools, lending markets and vaults. ZCHF is a standard ERC-20 with public price and supply data.

items.title: List your token as collateral
items.description: Let your holders borrow francs against your token. Anyone can propose; FCS holders can veto.

cta.title: Not sure where you fit?
cta.body: Write to the association. One email is enough; grants are available for integrations.
